headline: Reliance Home Finance Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process — Reliance Home Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about that the 12th Meeting of the Committee of Creditors ("CoC") of the Corporate Debtor, which was originally scheduled to be held on…
detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process — Reliance Home Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about that the 12th Meeting of the Committee of Creditors ("CoC") of the Corporate Debtor, which was originally scheduled to be held on Thursday, July 02, 2026 at 11:30 A.M. (IST) through Video Conferencing and was subsequently postponed, shall now be held as under:Date: Tuesday, July 14, 2026 Time: 11:30 A.M. (IST) Mode: Video Conferencing
